Uttar Pradesh SDM Transferred Amidst Public Dispute and Allegations

An administrative transfer has occurred for an SDM in Uttar Pradesh's Jalaun district following a public dispute. The official, Rinku Singh Rahi, was involved in a heated argument and alleged physical altercation with a Block Pramukh. A committee has been formed to investigate the incident, and the SDM has been reassigned to a judicial magistrate role.
